purpose: SEEGContactDetector is a 3D Slicer extension for automatic localization of stereoelectroencephalography (SEEG) electrode contact centers from post-implantation CT data, supporting optional MRI-based brain masking, manual correction tools, and interactive visualization.
summary: SEEGContactDetector is a robust and well-crafted 3D Slicer extension for automated localization of SEEG electrode contacts from post-implantation CT and preoperative MRI scans. Code structure adheres to Slicer conventions, with proper parameter node usage, UI management, cleanup, and Apache 2.0 licensing. All dependencies are correctly declared and optional Python packages are installed via standard Slicer prompts. 🟢 Recommend merge.

safety.rationale: Inspected SEEGContactDetector.py and verified that no malicious code, remote command execution, unsafe deserialization, or unauthorized data transmission exists. File saving is restricted to user-defined paths or auto-saves.

environment.rationale: Inspected SEEGContactDetector.py and CMakeLists.txt. Package installations are requested via slicer.util.confirmOkCancelDisplay / pip_install for scipy, scikit-learn, and scikit-image only when needed, and HDBrainExtraction is correctly declared in build_dependencies and EXTENSION_DEPENDS. No side effects at import or illegal PyTorch pinning.

packaging.rationale: Inspected CMakeLists.txt and SEEGContactDetector/CMakeLists.txt. All python scripts and resources are correctly registered with slicerMacroBuildScriptedModule.

license.rationale: Inspected LICENSE file, which contains the Apache License Version 2.0 allowing free distribution and use.

soundness.rationale: Inspected SEEGContactDetector.py. The module correctly uses ScriptedLoadableModule architecture, parameter node wrappers, proper VTK observer cleanup, and provides robust error handling and sample data registration.

utility.rationale: Inspected documentation files, README, TODO, tutorial video link, and test cases in SEEGContactDetector.py. The extension is well-documented, includes sample data, and features automated tests.

not_checked: External HDBrainExtraction extension source code (though standard dependency integration via HDBrainExtractionTool is used correctly)
